notes: Every file is untrusted until its sha256 matches. scripts/fetch-artifacts.mjs downloads into .cache/ (git-ignored), verifies, and the test verifies again before use.

pocket_ic: the release and the .gz digests are the ones eval/harness/artifacts.json pins (W2). linux-x64 was downloaded and unpacked for this package on 2026-10-12 (the .gz matched the pinned digest); darwin-arm64's unpacked sha256 is W2's observation. Platforms without an unpacked sha256 are refused.

sns_governance: built by DFINITY's CI at the dfinity/ic commit whose source docs/proposals/w4-sns-validator-rendering.md cites; both hashes equal the SHA256SUMS file published next to them (checked 2026-10-12). This is not necessarily the version deployed SNSes run (README, Open).
